senses.gloss:
द The third letter of the dental class, and eighteenth consonant in
the Deva Nagari alphabet, corresponding to the letter D.

द n. (-दं) A wife.
 nf. (दंदा)
 1. Gift, donation.
 2. Dividing, cutting,
breaking, &c.
 f. (दा)
 1. Purifying, cleansing.
 2. Preserving, cherish-
ing.
 3. Repentance.
 m. (दः)
 1. A donor, a giver.
 2. A mountain.
3. A gift, a thing given.
 E. दा to give, or दो to cut, &c. affix ड.

दा (ण) दाण r. 1st cl. (यच्छति, or with सम् prefixed संयच्छते) also (डु ञ)
डुदाञ् r. 3rd cl. (ददाति दत्ते) To give, to present. With आङ् prefixed
(आदत्ते), To take, to accept or receive. With प्र, To give, to give to,
With वि and आङ्, To open. With सम् and आङ्, To select. (प) दाप् r.
2nd cl. (दाति) To cut. भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् ण इत् । जुहो० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
